messages:
elaine-sales: OK team — NimbusPay POC kickoff. They're trying to swap CompetitorX for Redwood. Top asks from their pre-call: prompt parity, token billing differences, security questionnaire (SOC2/KMS), and enterprise blockers (SSO + IP allowlist). Can we do a quick smoke this week?

sam-solutions: yes. we can run a smoke in our staging pool. need: a few representative prompts + example API payloads from CompetitorX. ideally the prompts that showed the biggest output diffs.

priya-ml: heads-up — on a 50k prompt sample we saw ~+12-18% token delta w/ CompetitorX because they include a hidden system token and whitespace before messages. we should normalize whitespace and canonicalize role prefixes before counting. i'll run a quick tokenizer diff. :mag:

kevin-eng: infra notes: for the POC we can map their per-request pricing to our per-token model and tag requests with customer_id and "compat_poc". rate-limits: CompetitorX had per-min request caps; we can simulate with a temporary policy. Dedicated env for POC possible but needs 3-5 business days to provision if they want IP allowlist/VPC peering.

elaine-sales: pricing question from Nimbus: can we give a conservative monthly cost delta for their current traffic (est. 200M tokens/mo)? they want to know if switching increases their bill.

sam-solutions: rough calc: current CompetitorX charges ~$0.0012/token equivalent (their unit). With our observed +15% tokens, same model class => token bill ~1.15x. but with batching + KV cache we can likely bring unit cost below parity. propose: initial estimate 1.15x baseline, with plan to optimize during POC. i'll draft numbers and a short slide.

jordan-legal: they attached the security questionnaire. main red flags: KMS key control (bring-your-own), audit logs retention, and DPA clauses. @kevin-eng can you confirm BYOK + HSM options for Private/Dedicated? Also need a SOC2 attestation doc to share.

kevin-eng: BYOK/HSM supported for Private and Dedicated. hosted has KMS integration (customer-managed keys on request) but not full HSM unless Dedicated. we can provide SOC2 reports and an architecture diagram. for DPA, legal will need to review — @jordan-legal can you take the lead?

priya-ml: on prompt parity: we saw deterministic differences around stop-token handling and temperature rounding. quick mitigation: canonicalize stop sequences and post-process early stopping. also suggest a short evaluation harness: run 1000 seed prompts, compare exact-match + semantic similarity, and flag any systematic drift. i'll own that.

elaine-sales: they also asked about function calling differences (their app relies on compact JSON outputs). is Redwood function/tool calling compatible? any transforms needed?

sam-solutions: yes, function calling works. there are small differences in how we escape nested JSON strings. for the POC we'll provide a compatibility shim: a 5-line proxy that normalizes CompetitorX's "choices" -> Redwood's "outputs" mapping. example snippet to run in their staging: 

```
# compat proxy (python/flask pseudo)
@app.route('/v1/competitorx', methods=['POST'])
def proxy():
    body = request.json
    # normalize roles + strip leading whitespace
    body['prompt'] = normalize(body['prompt'])
    resp = redwood_client.generate(**map_to_redwood(body))
    return jsonify(map_to_competitorx(resp))
```

sam-solutions: that shim covers most surface-level diffs. for edge cases we'll log and iterate.

jordan-legal: enterprise blocker: Nimbus requires SSO (SAML + SCIM) and a signed DPA before starting any dedicated infra work. can we conditionally start the smoke w/out DPA if it's strictly hosted eval? they insisted on written assurance for data residency though.

kevin-eng: we can run a hosted eval (no dedicated infra) with anonymized data and controlled retention, but if they want IP allowlist or VPC peering we need the DPA & contract before provisioning Dedicated. FYI provisioning window 3-5 business days.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: staging/compat-poc (tags: nimbuspay, compat) started by sam-solutions — ETA ~22m

elaine-sales: plan: (1) sam/priya run smoke with their sample payloads tomorrow, (2) sam sends initial cost estimate slide by EOD, (3) jordan initiates DPA thread with Nimbus legal, (4) kev confirm infra lead times & BYOK details. i'll set a 30-min sync with Nimbus for Tue 11am PT.

sam-solutions: ack. i'll upload the smoke results + tokenizer diff into the shared drive and ping Nimbus with the dev webhook for the shim.

priya-ml: starting tokenizer diff now — will share a summary (token delta histogram + top 20 offenders).

jordan-legal: will draft DPA checklist and request SOC2, KMS details from kevin.

kevin-eng: noted. ping me if they need network IPs sooner; i'll prioritize provisioning once DPA in place.

elaine-sales: thanks all — keeping this thread as the single source for POC notes. :thumbsup:
